task.title: Surface ignored task refs in setup output and the sync watcher
task.description:
An ignored ref under origin's task namespace is reported only by the foreground fetch/push/sync text output and by the JSON envelope. Two surfaces where a user is most likely to meet a poisoned origin say nothing.

1. internal/cli/output.go:232-243 (writeSyncReport) prints only "Sync:\t<status>". Confirmed on a fresh clone against a poisoned origin: "workbook setup" prints "Sync: completed" with no mention of the stray ref, while "workbook setup --json" does carry data.sync.result.fetch.ignored. setup is the one bootstrap command product priority #2/#3 says a fresh clone runs, so it is exactly where a human first meets the problem.

2. internal/syncloop/loop.go:213-252 records only success/failure and conflicts, so "workbook sync --watch" and "workbook sync --status" never surface an ignored ref either.

Neither is required by the letter of the WB-01KZBT4D40T8493847N5HWMGCH acceptance criteria (fetch, push, and sync all report correctly), but the report reaches a user only if they happen to run a sync command in the foreground.

Fix direction: have writeSyncReport carry an ignored count or the ref names, and give the watcher snapshot a field for them alongside conflicts.

Deferred from PR #35 as a minor review finding: it is additive reporting across two more surfaces rather than part of the tolerance fix itself.
